fact: Sierra Leone's National Communications Authority signed a protocol with Guinea to introduce free mobile roaming between the two countries, finalised at the 15th session of the African Council of Regulators (CAR-15) alongside the Transform Africa 2025 Summit supported by Smart Africa; the document gives no event day, so its published date is used.

Liberia, The Gambia and Sierra Leone signed a memorandum of understanding on roaming, led by Liberia's telecom authority with Sierra Leone's National Communications Authority and The Gambia's regulator; the document gives no signing date, so the published date 2025-02-05 is used.

Liberia, Ghana and Sierra Leone entered the ECOWAS Free Roaming Agreement at a signing ceremony, to remove roaming charges among the three; the page carries no date, so the published date 2026-02-20 is used.

Sierra Leone's and Nigeria's communications ministries signed the Nigeria-Sierra Leone Digital Transformation Cooperation Framework in Freetown on day one of the 21-22 November 2025 bilateral mission.
system: Nigeria-Sierra Leone Digital Transformation Cooperation Framework

fact: On day two of the mission two technical partnerships were signed, one with Nigeria's NITDA on payment corridors and digital identity alignment and one on AI research and governance with Sierra Leone's ministry and NITDA.
Sierra Leone's regulator NatCA, through its deputy director of engineering, says it is part of the West Africa Telecommunications Regulators Assembly (WATRA).
